title: English Practice Quiz 0873
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A colleague says, 'I will handle the visitor register.' You reply to acknowledge:
options: Understood. Thank you for taking care of it.
questions.explanation: This confirms understanding and acknowledges responsibility.

questions.question: Which phrase is best when you did not hear an instruction?
options: Could you please repeat the last instruction?
questions.explanation: This is a polite request for clarification.

questions.question: You need to interrupt a meeting briefly. Say:
options: Excuse me, may I add one point?
questions.explanation: The phrase politely asks for a brief opportunity to speak.

questions.question: Which update communicates a delay clearly?
options: The inspection is delayed by 30 minutes because the technician is late.
questions.explanation: It states the delay, duration and reason.

questions.question: A person says, 'I will get back to you.' They mean:
questions.explanation: Get back to someone means contact them again with a response.

questions.question: Which phrase checks understanding?
options: Just to confirm, the meeting starts at ten, correct?
questions.explanation: The phrase politely verifies shared information.

questions.question: You are unable to complete a task on time. What should you do?
options: Inform the responsible person early and explain the reason
questions.explanation: Early communication gives the team time to adjust.

questions.question: Which is a professional way to disagree?
options: I see your point, but I suggest another approach.
questions.explanation: It recognises the other view and offers an alternative respectfully.

questions.question: A colleague asks for an update you do not yet have. Say:
options: I am waiting for confirmation and will update you shortly.
questions.explanation: This response is honest and sets an expectation.

questions.question: 'Please bear with me' means:
questions.explanation: Bear with me is a polite request for patience.
